title: equipo plugin settings (.claude/equipo.json and ~/.claude/equipo.json)
description: Every key is optional: anything missing takes its default. The project file goes on top of the user file.

ramaPrincipal.description: Branch every task branch is merged into.

idioma.description: Language (ISO 639-1 code: en, es, fr…) agents write commits, notices and documents in. Also the language of the plugin's own texts when it has a catalogue for it (es, en); English otherwise.

comandos.description: Commands the batch check and the worktree agents run.

compilar.description: Checks that the code compiles (build, type check, lint). Empty if there is nothing to compile.

probarArchivos.description: Runs only some tests: {archivos} is replaced by the list of test files. Empty: always use comandos.probar.

regenerar.description: Rebuilds the files listed in "generados" after a batch is merged (npm install, uv lock, go mod tidy…).

prohibidos.description: Files or folders (paths from the root, no wildcards; folders end in /) that never go into a commit.

decisiones.description: Numbered design decisions in one document, with a block of numbers reserved per branch.

documento.description: The document that holds the decisions.

prefijo.description: How decision headings start: "D" for "### D12. Title", "ADR-" for "## ADR-12 Title".

bloque.description: How many numbers each branch gets.

backlog.description: Backlog kept as a table with a code in the first cell; branches prefix new codes with their name and the main copy renumbers them on merge.

unir.description: Documents where, if two branches only append lines at the same spot, both additions are kept (changelogs, logs).

generados.description: Patterns (.gitattributes syntax) of derived files: on a merge conflict the current version is kept, then comandos.regenerar rebuilds them. Never real source files.

patron.description: Regular expression over paths from the root that says which files are tests. The default covers the usual conventions of JS/TS, Python, Rust, Go, JVM, .NET, PHP, Ruby, Elixir, Dart and Swift.

pendientes.description: Document where /pendiente, the encargo skill and the batch check write what is in progress and what was left untested.

fusion.description: How a branch enters the main branch.

estrategia.description: "merge": a merge commit (--no-ff). "squash": a single commit with the whole branch.

contexto.description: The context bar above the prompt.

aviso.description: Percentage of the context window from which the bar turns yellow.

peligro.description: Percentage of the context window from which the bar turns red.

barridos.description: In the main copy, reject "git add -A", "git add .", "git add -u" and "git commit -a". The "prohibidos" list is enforced either way.

gestor.description: Who creates and closes them: "orca", "git" (plain git worktree) or "auto" (Orca when it is in PATH, git otherwise).

carpeta.description: With git: folder of each worktree, relative to the main copy. {repo} is the main copy's folder name and {nombre} the task's short name.

prefijoRama.description: With git: what goes before the task name to form the branch ("ana/" gives ana/cart).

cerrarAlSubir.description: Close a branch's worktree once the batch check approves it.

lanzar.description: With git worktrees: how the agent's session is opened. Depends on the machine, so it usually belongs in ~/.claude/equipo.json.

preajuste.description: "auto" detects it (tmux inside tmux, Windows Terminal, Terminal.app or iTerm on macOS, otherwise manual); "manual" opens nothing and gives a command to paste; "propio" runs lanzar.orden.

orden.description: With "propio": the command as a list (program and arguments, no shell). {ruta}, {nombre} and {prompt} are replaced. It must return right away.

repo.description: The repository's name in Orca; empty means the name of the main copy's folder.

sesionPrincipal.description: How the main session's name starts in ListAgents, so worktree agents know whom to notify; empty means derived from the folder name.

textos.description: Texts of the plugin replaced by your own: { "<key>": "<template with {placeholders}>" }.
